name_en: Per Drop More Crop - Micro Irrigation (Drip/Sprinkler)
department: Department of Horticulture and Plantation Crops, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: You get help to put drip or sprinkler irrigation on your farm. Small and marginal farmers get 100% subsidy, up to 2 hectares. Other farmers get 75% subsidy, up to 5 hectares. The Tamil Nadu Government pays the GST on the parts.

other: You must own or share a water source with a pump.
The land can be your own land or leased land.

where_to_apply: Village level: Assistant Horticulture Officer. Block level: Assistant Director of Horticulture or Horticulture Officer. District level: Joint or Deputy Director of Horticulture.
gaps: The charter does not list documents or the online steps.
The charter text is in columns, so quotes are short pieces of one table row.
Forest Rights Act patta holders have a separate rate (100% / 90%) not covered here.
